summary: Taichung's 2026 electric-scooter subsidy figures could not be verified: the city environmental bureau site and the Liberty Times article were both unreachable. Leads only: about NT$3,000 for a new electric purchase (plus NT$3,000 if you have a child aged 12 or under), and roughly NT$5,000-13,000 more for scrapping an old scooter, with hybrids at half. A NT$31,500 headline maximum is unexplained. Do not put these in the calculator until the official 115年 plan is read. Quotas, deadlines, stacking with central subsidies, local perks and 2027 status are unknown.
